# Count distinct packages (parent dirs of .go files) outside store/ referencing each entity type
entities="User Memo Attachment Reaction Inbox IdentityProvider MemoRelation MemoShare UserIdentity UserSetting InstanceSetting Role Visibility RowStatus"

for ent in $entities; do
  pkgs=$(grep -rl "store\.$ent\b\|\*store\.$ent\b" /bench/repo --include="*.go" 2>/dev/null \
    | grep -v _test.go \
    | grep -v "^/bench/repo/store/" \
    | xargs -I{} dirname {} \
    | sort -u)
  cnt=$(echo "$pkgs" | grep -c . || echo 0)
  echo "=== $ent: $cnt packages ==="
  echo "$pkgs" | head -20
done

args.command:
# Count unique Go packages (directory containing go files with same package name)
count_pkgs() {
  ent="$1"
  grep -rlE "store\.${ent}\b|\*store\.${ent}\b" /bench/repo --include="*.go" 2>/dev/null \
    | grep -v _test.go \
    | grep -v "^/bench/repo/store/" \
    | while read f; do
      pkg=$(grep "^package " "$f" | head -1 | awk '{print $2}')
      dir=$(dirname "$f")
      echo "${dir}|${pkg}"
    done | sort -u
}

for ent in User Memo Attachment Reaction Inbox MemoShare UserIdentity MemoRelation Visibility Role; do
  result=$(count_pkgs "$ent")
  cnt=$(echo "$result" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)
  echo "=== $ent: $cnt packages ==="
  echo "$result"
  echo
done
